name: ComfyUI
description: The most powerful and modular diffusion model GUI, api and backend with a graph/nodes interface. The fastest local inference engine in the world.
one_liner: A visual, node-based app for generating and editing images, video, 3D, and audio with AI models, running on your own computer instead of a paid cloud service.
buyer: A small e-commerce seller who currently pays a photographer or stock-photo site for every new product listing.
business_use_cases: An e-commerce store owner generates consistent, on-brand product photography variations (different backgrounds, angles, lifestyle shots) without booking a shoot.
A YouTuber or news explainer channel generates illustrative b-roll and thumbnail art for stories where no real footage exists.
A local print-on-demand or small design studio offers AI-generated custom art and mockups as a cheap add-on service to clients.

money_ideas.idea: Build pre-made ComfyUI workflows for a specific niche (product photography, book covers, thumbnail art) and sell them as templates.
Run a 'generate your product photos' service where clients upload one real photo and get back a full catalog shoot.
Offer a monthly managed-ComfyUI hosting plan for creators who don't want to manage GPUs themselves.

steal_this: Build one polished product-photography workflow this weekend (plain product shot in, five styled lifestyle variants out) and sell it as a $20 one-off service to five local Etsy or Shopify sellers.
